how: We read the website of every Minneapolis wedding DJ listed on Lazo (37 listings, 26 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national multi-service chain, a photo and video company that also DJs, and a site with no real text. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle ceremony audio outdoors or in a barn with no house system, and in a cold-weather tent?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Instant Request DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: Instant Request in Bloomington lists two MN Bride 2025 wins and says Shawn, Matt and the team have spent decades on weddings. Its own online event planner lets you build the reception at your pace, with ceremony audio, lighting, custom DJ booths and cold sparklers as add-ons and backup systems promised.

picks.name: Golden Touch DJ
picks.blurb: Bill Young founded Golden Touch in 2006 after a drum line with the Minnesota Brass and a professional dance career, and has more than 500 events behind him. A one-man Plymouth operation that travels the Twin Cities, western Wisconsin and out of state.

picks.name: Music Mix Entertainment
picks.blurb: Mannix Clark started Music Mix in Gainesville, Florida in 1996 and brought it to the Twin Cities in 2000. Most weddings get two DJs, one acting as emcee, plus online planning tools, guest song requests by text and a pre-wedding meeting; photo booths and uplighting are extra.

picks.name: Better-DJs
picks.blurb: Better DJs was formed by Freddy Fresh, a producer and DJ with 35 years and over 35 countries of club and festival work who also ran the DJ program at McNally Smith College of Music for nine years. Packages include consultations with your DJ and an app for picking music; St. Paul based, travel priced by distance.

picks.name: Lens On Records LLC
tags: DJ plus photo booth and karaoke
picks.blurb: Mishereen 'DJ Malicious' Ellis has over 20 years behind the decks and runs Lens On Records in Minneapolis as a one-stop shop: DJ, event photography, photo booth, karaoke, silent disco and day-of coordination. Her rule is to play what the crowd wants, not what the DJ wants to hear.

picks.name: Eclectic Entertainment with DJ E
picks.blurb: DJ Eric quotes flat fees, no per-hour charge: a Basic package at $600 with music, two speakers and a wireless mic, and Medium at $800 for bigger rooms. Sixteen years of experience, and since 2025 he is also the DJ partner for Fab! Weddings venues.

picks.name: Northern Sound Entertainment
picks.blurb: Northern Sound in White Bear Lake has provided wedding DJs since 2014 and makes a point of letting you meet your DJ before the day and customize the playlist. Photo booths and videography come from the same company.

picks.name: DJ Aaron Strawn
picks.blurb: Aaron Strawn prints two pricing packages with no surprises because, as he puts it, what something costs is nice to know before a consultation. Every client gets a mobile app for music and the day-of schedule, with 12 wireless uplights and a photo booth available.

picks.name: Harmony DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: Harmony is a Twin Cities collective of DJs and live musicians: Matt is a music teacher with over 20 years of DJ and saxophone experience, and Valerie pairs sax melodies with the DJ's set. Emceeing, lighting and AV are offered too.

picks.name: Minnesota Wedding Party - Video DJ
picks.blurb: Minnesota Wedding Party is a video DJ: music videos on screen for the dance floor, with MC hosting, an audio guestbook and photo booth rentals. The St. Paul company calls itself a proud ally to the LGBTQIA+ community and says it celebrates every love story rather than merely accepting it.

picks.name: Midwest Sound DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: Midwest Sound in Roseville has done wedding entertainment in Minnesota and western Wisconsin for over 49 years. The site is built around couples' own accounts of their DJs, with a brochure to download and virtual appointments offered.

picks.name: Turn N Heads Productions - Wedding DJ & Photobooth
picks.blurb: Neil Turner has 25+ years as a professional DJ and runs Turn N Heads from Anoka, covering ceremony to last dance as DJ and master of ceremonies. Photo booths including a 360 booth, an audio guest book and karaoke are on the menu for all of Minnesota.
